# PartDesign Pad

The **PartDesign Pad** tool extrudes a sketch or face along its normal direction.

## Description

The Pad tool creates a solid by extruding a closed sketch profile along a given direction.

## Properties

* `Profile` -- The sketch to be padded
* `Length` -- The length of the pad
* `Type` -- The type of pad extent
* `Reversed` -- Whether the pad direction is reversed
* `Symmetric` -- Whether to pad symmetrically
* `Midplane` -- Whether to pad from the midplane

## Methods

* `execute()` -- Recomputes the pad feature
